question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the given word.

Insipid
solution:
The correct answer is '**bland**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**insipid**" means lacking flavor, dull, or uninteresting. (नीरस)
 
• In this context, "**bland**" is the most appropriate synonym for "**insipid**" as it also means lacking strong taste or character.
 
• The other options: "**spicy**," "**tangy**," and "**flavourful**" are antonyms of "**insipid**" and do not fit the context.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Sentence:** *The soup was bland__, lacking any distinct flavour or spice.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Spicy (मसालेदार)**: means having a strong, pungent flavour due to spices.
 
• **Tangy (चटपटा)**: means having a sharp or acidic taste.
 
• **Flavourful (स्वादिष्ट)**: means full of flavor or tasty.
